Search every harmonized evidence record — all genes in all reanalysed study contrasts, including
nonsignificant results — not just the ten displayed findings per study. The full table
(~17&nbsp;MB) downloads into your browser once; every query then runs locally, and nothing you
type leaves the page.

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
These are study-level molecular associations, not validated biomarkers. Higher expression does not
necessarily mean greater resilience, rows that share controls are not independent replication, and
no cross-study pooled effect is computed. Rows marked **exploratory** come from the tank-dependent
PRJNA735889 analysis: their p-values are nominal only. See
[how expression findings relate to resilience](docs/interpreting-evidence.md#how-expression-findings-relate-to-resilience)
and the [guide to reading results](docs/methods.md#reading-the-results).
:::

```{=html}

<div class="aree-query-controls">

    <select id="aree-study" disabled><option value="">All</option></select>

    <label for="aree-direction">Direction</label>
    <select id="aree-direction" disabled>
      <option value="">Any</option>
      <option value="up">Higher in treatment</option>

    </select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="aree-fdr">Significance</label>
    <select id="aree-fdr" disabled>
      <option value="">All records</option>

<p style="font-size:.85rem; opacity:.75;">Positive effects indicate higher expression in the
treatment relative to the control. Adjusted p-values from the exploratory PRJNA735889 contrast are

<details>
  <summary>Advanced: run SQL against the <code>evidence</code> table</summary>
  <p style="font-size:.85rem; margin:.5rem 0;">Columns match the harmonized evidence schema:
  <code>study_id, bioproject, feature_id_standardized, description, sample_comparison, effect_size,

  <textarea id="aree-sql" rows="4" spellcheck="false">SELECT stressor, count(*) AS records, count(DISTINCT study_id) AS contrasts

  <button id="aree-sql-run" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" style="margin:.5rem 0;" disabled>Run SQL</button>

<script type="module" src="query.js"></script>
```

Prefer a script or a chatbot? The same file powers both: download
[`aree_evidence.parquet`](downloads/aree_evidence.parquet) and query it with DuckDB, pandas or
polars, or hand its URL to an AI assistant. Full per-study TSVs with complete provenance columns
are linked from [real-study findings](candidates.qmd).
